rules.title: Cartwright Act: ban on using or distributing a common pricing algorithm as part of a conspiracy
rules.requirement: A person may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce. The provision applies to prices generally and does not specifically mention rents.
rules.coverage_text: Any person (excluding the end consumer of a product or service) who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm, meaning any methodology, including a computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons, that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term.
rules.exemptions: "Person" does not include the end consumer of a product or service.
rules.citation: Business and Professions Code Section 16729(a) (AB 325, Chapter 338)
rules.penalty: The legislative digest states that violation of the Cartwright Act is punishable as a crime.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
rules.interaction_text: (c) Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.

rules.title: Cartwright Act: ban on coercing adoption of common pricing algorithm recommendations
rules.requirement: A person may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a price or commercial term recommended by the algorithm for the same or similar products or services in California. The provision applies to prices generally and does not specifically mention rents.
rules.coverage_text: Any person (excluding the end consumer of a product or service) who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm, meaning any methodology, including a computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons, that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term.
rules.exemptions: "Person" does not include the end consumer of a product or service.
rules.citation: Business and Professions Code Section 16729(b) (AB 325, Chapter 338)
rules.penalty: The legislative digest states that violation of the Cartwright Act is punishable as a crime.
rules.quoted_span: (b) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.interaction_text: (c) Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.
